setting: Haulage yard off the M62, West Yorkshire, 3 a.m., rain. We are in the transport office: the base radio is on Mick's desk.

MICK.name: Paul - Deep & Warm - Yorkshire
MICK.note: user's pick of five (24 Nov). Night planner, 50s. In the office with us (room voice) until he leaves.

ASH.name: Ashley - Bright, Yorkshire
ASH.note: user's pick of five; the gate man, renamed Ash (was Dave). Always on the radio.

KAREN.name: Kirsty - Yorkshire
KAREN.note: user's pick of four. Steve's wife, on Mick's mobile on speaker.

STEVE.name: Tony - Middle-aged, Northern
STEVE.note: the Mick option not taken; only ever faint, behind the gatehouse glass, under Ash's open radio.

lines.text: That's the last one in. Barrier's down.
Champion. That's thirty home. Keys are on the board.
What's Steve left you?
Usual. OEU has an AdBlue fault, for a change. Wakefield's moved to half five.
lines.say: Usual. O. E. U. has an AdBlue fault, for a change. Wakefield's moved to half five.

lines.text: "Don't let anyone in after three." Underlined. "Not even me." Underlined twice.
lines.say: Don't let anyone in after three. Underlined. Not even me. Underlined twice.

lines.text: He's on a wind-up.
Daft sod's left his phone an' all.
Fourteen missed calls. No number.
Bookies.
Three o'clock. Gate's locked, barrier's down, it's siling it down and I'm frozen. All quiet.
Nobody in after three, Ash.
Not even Steve.
Mick. You'll not believe this. Steve's at the gate.
lines.note: the barrier motor is buried under this line (the re-listen): it opened at 3:20

lines.text: You what?
On foot. Says he's left his phone.
He has. It's here.
So I'll let him in, then.
What's the note say?
Oh, give over. He's wet through.
Where's his car?
... He's walked.
He lives out Holmfirth. That's twenty mile.
lines.say: He lives out Homfirth. That's twenty mile.

lines.text: He'll not look up at the camera. He keeps looking up the lane.
Is he coming down?
He's asking for you. Not the phone. You.
Please, Ash.
Steve's never said please in his life.
lines.note: to himself, not on the radio; then he rings Steve's house

lines.text: Hello?
Karen, it's Mick at the yard. Is Steve there?
No, love. Someone rang the house about half two. He went white. Went straight out. Wouldn't say who.
He said if you rang, I've to tell you to read his note again.
Not even me.
Mick? Is he with you? Is he all right?
I'll ring you back, love.
Mick. There's summat up the lane.
What?
An engine. Just ticking over. No lights. I never heard it come.
Please.
I'm letting him in.
Don't you dare.
He's stood in the rain, Mick. It's Steve!
Don't open it. I'm coming down.
Ash. Where is he?
Where's who?
Steve.
Steve's not been here, mate. Radio's been quiet all night.
Why's the barrier up?
It's not, it's... It says it's been up since twenty past three.
Ash... who's that in my office?

notes.ending: After h49 the transmission drops; the office: rain, hiss; then keys lifted off the board, close; cut.
notes.room: Mick is a room voice (PTT clicks when he talks to Ash) until he leaves at h42; aside lines have no PTT.
notes.plants: barrier (h01, full; h13, buried) and keys (h02, hung; the end, lifted).
